scanNote: TEKSHIRILDI (skan 49-bet): uchala otkritka matni so'zma-so'z skan bilan solishtirildi - A (Tom, Warsaw, Sally Jones/12 Swan St/London SW1 4GB), B (Tracy, London, Mr & Mrs Johnson/2 Via Torino/Rome/Italy), C (Pamela, Sydney, Mrs Bessie Bates/27 Park Lane/London SW3 9RY) - hammasi mos. 4 ta savol va kiyim gaplari (wearing heavy jackets and gloves / in their pyjamas / in our swimming costumes) to'g'ri. Speaking sarlavhalari city-weather-clothes-activities va namuna gap mos. Xato topilmadi.

exercises.instructionEn: Read postcard A (from Tom in Warsaw).
exercises.explanationUz:
OTKRITKA (a postcard) TUZILISHI:

  1) Murojaat:     Dear Sally,
  2) Salomlashish: A Happy New Year to all of you.
  3) Asosiy qism:  ob-havo, kiyim, mashg'ulot
  4) Yakun:        Hope to see you soon.
  5) Xayrlashuv:   Best wishes,
  6) Imzo:         Tom

MANZIL (o'ng tomonda):
  Sally Jones          — ism
  12 Swan St           — ko'cha va uy raqami
  London SW1 4GB       — shahar va pochta indeksi
  England              — mamlakat

DIQQAT: inglizcha manzil KICHIKDAN KATTAGA yoziladi
(ism → ko'cha → shahar → mamlakat).

sentences.en: Dear Sally,
sentences.noteUz:
'Dear + ism' — xat va otkritkaning odatiy boshlanishi.
O'zbekchadagidek 'Assalomu alaykum' emas.

sentences.en: A Happy New Year to all of you.
sentences.noteUz:
'A Happy New Year to you' — tabrik shakli.
'all of you' = hammangiz.

sentences.en: You can't imagine how cold it is in Warsaw!
sentences.uz: Varshavada qanchalik sovuq ekanini tasavvur ham qila olmaysiz!
sentences.noteUz:
'to imagine' = tasavvur qilmoq.
'how cold it is' — bilvosita gapda tartib O'ZGARMAYDI:
'how cold IS it' XATO.

sentences.en: It is snowing heavily today, so the children are wearing their heavy jackets and gloves to keep them warm.
sentences.uz: Bugun qor qalin yog'yapti, shuning uchun bolalar issiq turish uchun qalin kurtka va qo'lqop kiyib olishgan.
sentences.noteUz:
KIYIM HAQIDAGI GAP — 7-mashqda tagiga chiziladi.
'so' = shuning uchun (sabab-natija).
'to keep them warm' — 40-betdagi pingvin matnidagi ibora.

sentences.en: They are making a snowman in the park at the moment.
sentences.noteUz:
'a snowman' = qorbobo (snow + man).
'at the moment' = ayni paytda — Present Continuous belgisi.

sentences.en: Hope to see you soon.
sentences.noteUz: '(I) hope to see you soon' — ega tushirilgan, otkritkada odatiy.

sentences.en: Best wishes, Tom
sentences.noteUz: 'Best wishes' — do'st va tanishlarga yoziladigan xayrlashuv.

exercises.instructionEn: Read postcard B (from Tracy in London).
exercises.explanationUz:
MANZIL:
  Mr & Mrs Johnson   — janob va xonim Jonson
  2 Via Torino       — ko'cha (italyancha nom)
  Rome               — Rim
  Italy              — Italiya

Demak, Treysi Londondan Rimdagi ota-onasiga yozyapti.

DIQQAT: 'Mr' (janob) va 'Mrs' (turmush qurgan xonim) —
dan keyin nuqta qo'yilmaydi (britancha).

sentences.en: Dear Mum and Dad,
sentences.noteUz: Ota-onaga murojaat. Britanchada 'Mum', amerikachada 'Mom'.

sentences.en: Greetings from London.
sentences.noteUz:
'Greetings from ...' — otkritkaning odatiy boshlanishi.
'a greeting' = salom, tabrik.

sentences.en: It's windy today and it is raining.
sentences.noteUz: Ikki usul birga: SIFAT ('windy') va FE'L ('is raining').

sentences.en: The children are in their pyjamas in the living-room.
sentences.noteUz:
KIYIM HAQIDAGI GAP — 7-mashqda tagiga chiziladi.
'pyjamas' DOIM ko'plikda (shim + ko'ylak).
'be IN + kiyim' = kiygan holda bo'lmoq.

sentences.en: They are very happy as they are decorating the Christmas tree at the moment.
sentences.uz: Ular juda xursand, chunki hozir Rojdestvo archasini bezashayapti.
sentences.noteUz:
'as' bu yerda = 'because' (chunki).
'to decorate' = bezamoq.
'the Christmas tree' = Rojdestvo archasi (yangi yil archasi).

sentences.en: We miss you a lot.
sentences.noteUz:
'to miss somebody' = sog'inmoq.
'a lot' = juda ko'p (gap oxirida).

sentences.en: Love, Tracy
sentences.noteUz:
'Love' — YAQIN kishilarga (oila, do'st) yoziladigan xayrlashuv.
Rasmiy xatda ishlatilmaydi.

exercises.instructionEn: Read postcard C (from Pamela in Sydney).
exercises.explanationUz:
MANZIL:
  Mrs Bessie Bates   — Bessi Beyts xonim
  27 Park Lane       — ko'cha
  London SW3 9RY     — shahar va indeks
  England            — mamlakat

QIZIQ FAKT — UCHALA OTKRITKA HAM YANGI YIL PAYTIDA YOZILGAN:
  Tom (Varshava)  — 'A Happy New Year'  → QOR
  Tracy (London)  — 'Christmas tree'    → YOMG'IR
  Pamela (Sidney) — 'Season's greetings' → PLYAJ, ISSIQ

SABABI: Avstraliya JANUBIY yarim sharda joylashgan —
u yerda dekabr YOZ oyi! Fasllar teskari bo'ladi.

sentences.en: Dear Aunt Bessie,
sentences.noteUz: 'Aunt' = xola, amma, ammaki. Ism oldida BOSH harf bilan.

sentences.en: Season's greetings from Sydney.
sentences.noteUz:
'Season's greetings' — Rojdestvo va Yangi yil tabrigi.
So'zma-so'z: 'faslning salomlari'.

sentences.en: The weather is fantastic today and we are on the beach.
sentences.uz: Bugun ob-havo ajoyib va biz plyajdamiz.
sentences.noteUz:
'fantastic' = ajoyib, zo'r.
'ON the beach' — plyaj yuzasida → ON.

sentences.en: It's very hot and the sun is shining, so we are all in our swimming costumes.
sentences.uz: Juda issiq va quyosh charaqlayapti, shuning uchun hammamiz cho'milish kiyimidamiz.
sentences.noteUz:
KIYIM HAQIDAGI GAP — 7-mashqda tagiga chiziladi.
'so' = shuning uchun.
'we are all' = hammamiz (all egadan KEYIN).

sentences.en: Mum, Dad, Sheila and Frank are making a sandcastle.
sentences.uz: Oyim, dadam, Sheyla va Frenk qumdan qal'a yasashayapti.
sentences.noteUz:
'a sandcastle' = qum qal'a (sand + castle).
Sanashda oxirgisidan oldin 'and'.

sentences.en: There are a lot of people on the beach today.
sentences.uz: Bugun plyajda juda ko'p odam bor.
sentences.noteUz:
'people' — ko'plik ot → ARE.
'a lot of' = juda ko'p.

sentences.en: Everyone is swimming and enjoying the good weather.
sentences.uz: Hamma suzyapti va yaxshi ob-havodan zavqlanayapti.
sentences.noteUz:
'everyone' — shakli birlik → IS ('everyone are' XATO).
'to enjoy' = zavqlanmoq, huzur qilmoq.

sentences.en: Come and see us soon!
sentences.noteUz:
Buyruq gap — taklif ma'nosida.
'come and + fe'l' = kelib ...moq.

sentences.en: Lots of love, Pamela
sentences.noteUz: 'Lots of love' — 'Love' ning kuchliroq shakli, oila a'zolariga.

exercises.instructionEn: Underline the sentences which describe the people's clothes in each picture.
exercises.instructionUz: Har bir rasmda odamlarning kiyimini tasvirlaydigan gaplar tagiga chizing.
exercises.explanationUz:
Har bir otkritkada KIYIM haqida BITTA gap bor.
Shu gaplarni topish kerak.

KIYIM HAQIDA GAPIRISHNING IKKI USULI:
  1) to WEAR + kiyim:  They are wearing heavy jackets.
  2) to BE IN + kiyim: They are in their pyjamas.
  Ikkalasi ham bir xil ma'noda.

items.answer: The children are wearing their heavy jackets and gloves to keep them warm.
items.whyUz: Qorli va sovuq ob-havoga mos kiyim: qalin kurtka va qo'lqop.

items.answer: The children are in their pyjamas in the living-room.
items.whyUz:
Uy ichida bo'lgani uchun pijamada.
'be IN + kiyim' — 'wear' bilan bir xil ma'noda.

items.answer: We are all in our swimming costumes.
items.whyUz: Issiq va plyajda bo'lgani uchun cho'milish kiyimida.

exercises.explanationUz:
Javoblarni otkritkalardan toping.
2, 3, 4-savollar 'What are ... doing?' shaklida —
demak javob ham Present Continuous bo'ladi.

items.textEn: 1  What is the weather like in Warsaw?
items.answer: It is very cold and it is snowing heavily.
items.whyUz: Tom: 'You can't imagine how cold it is in Warsaw! It is snowing heavily today.'

items.textEn: 1  What is the weather like in London?
items.answer: It's windy and it is raining.
items.whyUz: Treysi: 'It's windy today and it is raining.'

items.textEn: 1  What is the weather like in Sydney?
items.answer: It's very hot and the sun is shining.
items.whyUz:
Pamela: 'It's very hot and the sun is shining.'
Ob-havo 'fantastic' (ajoyib) deb ham baholangan.

items.answer: They are making a snowman in the park.
items.hintUz: A otkritka, qor bilan nima qilinadi?
items.whyUz: Tom: 'They are making a snowman in the park at the moment.'

items.answer: They are decorating the Christmas tree.
items.whyUz: Treysi: 'they are decorating the Christmas tree at the moment'.

items.answer: They are making a sandcastle. Everyone is swimming and enjoying the good weather.
items.whyUz:
Pamela: 'Mum, Dad, Sheila and Frank are making a sandcastle' va
'Everyone is swimming and enjoying the good weather.'

exercises.instructionEn: Read the postcards again and make notes about each under these headings: city — weather — clothes — activities. Then, look at your notes and talk about each person, as in the example.
exercises.instructionUz: Otkritkalarni qayta o'qing va har biri haqida quyidagi sarlavhalar ostida qayd yozing: shahar — ob-havo — kiyim — mashg'ulot. So'ng qaydlaringizga qarab har bir odam haqida gapiring.
exercises.explanationUz:
KITOBDAGI NAMUNA:
  'Tom is in Warsaw. It's very cold there and it is snowing ...'

TO'RT SARLAVHA:
  city ....... shahar
  weather .... ob-havo
  clothes .... kiyim
  activities . mashg'ulotlar

QAYD YOZISH USULI: to'liq gap emas, faqat KALIT so'zlar.
  Tom — Warsaw — very cold, snowing heavily —
        heavy jackets, gloves — making a snowman

items.whyUz: 'Greetings from ...' o'rniga Tom 'how cold it is in Warsaw' deydi.
'how cold it is' + 'It is snowing heavily today'.
'the children are wearing their heavy jackets and gloves'.

items.answer: making a snowman in the park
items.whyUz: 'They are making a snowman in the park at the moment.'
'Greetings from London.'
'It's windy today and it is raining.'
'The children are in their pyjamas.'
'they are decorating the Christmas tree at the moment'.
'Season's greetings from Sydney.'
'The weather is fantastic today' + 'It's very hot and the sun is shining'.
'we are all in our swimming costumes'.

'Mum, Dad, Sheila and Frank are making a sandcastle' +
'Everyone is swimming and enjoying the good weather'.

exercises.instructionEn: Then, look at your notes and talk about each person, as in the example.
exercises.instructionUz: So'ng qaydlaringizga qarab har bir odam haqida gapiring.
exercises.explanationUz:
KITOBDAGI NAMUNA:
  'Tom is in Warsaw. It's very cold there and it is snowing ...'

QOLIP:
  Ism + IS IN + shahar.
  It's + ob-havo + THERE.
  He/She/They + ARE WEARING / ARE IN + kiyim.
  They + ARE + mashg'ulot-ING.

'there' = u yerda — shaharni qayta aytmaslik uchun.

example.uz: U yerda juda sovuq va qor qalin yog'yapti.

example.uz: Uning bolalari qalin kurtka va qo'lqop kiyib olishgan.

groups.explanationUz: Ikki so'z birikib yangi ot yasaydi.
Boshlanish va yakun uchun tayyor shakllar.
Ikki oyoq yoki ikki qo'l uchun bo'lgani sababli -s bilan keladi.
Bu so'zlar hozir sodir bo'layotgan ishni bildiradi.
Ma'nosi ko'plik bo'lsa ham, GRAMMATIK jihatdan BIRLIK.

patterns.exampleEn: They are making a snowman. It is snowing heavily.
patterns.exampleUz: Ular qorbobo yasashayapti. Qor qalin yog'yapti.
patterns.explanationUz:
HOZIR sodir bo'layotgan ish.
Vaqt so'zlari: now, at the moment, today.

patterns.formula: someone IS WEARING + kiyim  /  someone IS IN + kiyim.
patterns.exampleEn: The children are wearing their heavy jackets. The children are in their pyjamas.
patterns.exampleUz: Bolalar qalin kurtka kiyib olishgan. Bolalar pijamada.
patterns.explanationUz:
Ikki qolip ham bir xil ma'noda.
'be in' qolipi qisqaroq va tabiiyroq eshitiladi.

patterns.exampleEn: It is snowing heavily today, so the children are wearing their heavy jackets.
patterns.exampleUz: Bugun qor qalin yog'yapti, shuning uchun bolalar qalin kurtka kiyishgan.

patterns.exampleEn: They are very happy as they are decorating the Christmas tree.
patterns.exampleUz: Ular juda xursand, chunki archani bezashayapti.
patterns.explanationUz: 'as' bu yerda 'because' bilan bir xil ma'noda.

patterns.formula: You can't imagine HOW + sifat + IT IS.
patterns.exampleEn: You can't imagine how cold it is in Warsaw!
patterns.exampleUz: Varshavada qanchalik sovuq ekanini tasavvur qila olmaysiz!
patterns.explanationUz:
Bilvosita gapda so'z tartibi ODDIY qoladi:
'how cold IT IS' — 'how cold IS IT' XATO.

patterns.formula: Ism + is in + shahar. It's + ob-havo + there.
patterns.exampleEn: Tom is in Warsaw. It's very cold there and it is snowing.
patterns.exampleUz: Tom Varshavada. U yerda juda sovuq va qor yog'yapti.
patterns.explanationUz: 'there' = u yerda — shahar nomini takrorlamaslik uchun.
